name: Mitos Town
source:
Amanda's car breaks down on the way to a wedding. No phone, no tools – just panic. She heads toward the nearest town, Mitos.

But a man stops her: "Don't go there." She ignores him. The townsfolk seem… strange. But she's sure it'll be fine. It has to be. Right?

[From [url=https://ccc123p.itch.io/mitos-town]Itch.io[/url]]
